newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-SBC Warburg ups MAM target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SBC Warburg ups MAM target.

text.p: Analysts at SBC Warburg raised their price target for Mercury Asset Management Plc shares and repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
With MAM shares having risen sharply in recent months, SBC Warburg upped its target on the fund management company to 15.00 stg and said it would be wrong to be a seller of the stock, dealers said.
Analysts at the brokerage also repeated their positive stance on M&G Group Plc, up 3-1/2p at 13.80 stg, and Invesco, up 1/2p at 307-1/2, dealers said.

Today's rise in MAM shares extended Friday's surge sparked by a renewed bout of bid talk after the merger agreement between Morgan Stanley and Dean Witter. Schroders Plc also built on Friday's gain, up 17-1/2p at 17.70 stg.
